data.exact_reserve_text: Change in estimates of prior year provisions (8,228) 4,269 (3,959)
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 were GBP 60.867m. During 2024 there was a net decrease in gross prior-year claims provisions of GBP 8.228m (a release), with an increase in the reinsurers' share of prior-year provisions of GBP 4.269m, resulting in a net prior-year improvement of GBP 3.959m. The movement is recorded in the Technical Provisions note and is described as a change in estimates of prior year provisions.
